description: Local-first personal agentic OS and everything app.
notes: Electron NSIS installer (64-bit). Two-layer extraction: 7z-extract the installer payload, then Expand-7zipArchive the inner $PLUGINSDIR/app-64.7z which contains 'CoWork OS.exe'.
GUI desktop app; user and config data is stored by the app under %APPDATA%\CoWork OS (Electron userData), not managed by Scoop persistence.

The release ships no checksum file for the Windows installer; the only checksum asset (cowork-os-server-linux-x64-v0.5.52.tar.gz.sha256) covers the Linux server tarball, so the Windows installer SHA-256 is pinned in the manifest.
